subhypotheses.claim: ODD and exit/recovery conditions bound an ADS scaling claim.
ADS assurance is layered across sensing, planning, degradation, and human/system interaction.
Infrastructure and V2X need explicit availability/integrity/failure treatment.
Mixed traffic, public acceptance, privacy, and responsibility are scaling evidence domains.

prohibited_inferences: Do not convert current driver-assistance availability into full-automation availability.
Do not represent communication as a guaranteed or safe substitute for local fallback.
Do not infer city-wide deployment from a bounded pilot or an individual technical component.
Do not equate public awareness or stated preference with informed consent or legitimate deployment.
